bootstrap: Observe and log existing rows without opening positions. Only source alerts and whole parent waves beginning strictly after study start can enter the forward sample.
candidate_clock: First response receipt in which all fixed prerequisites were seen together; raw-first-seen is logged separately. Recorded transaction-start clocks remain annotations, never a first-read substitute.
late_rows: Previously frozen parent winner is immutable, including when an older recorded timestamp arrives later.
entry: Strict next full minute after first eligible response receipt; first quote request starting at/after planned entry. Expire after 90 seconds. Capacity gated at planned time; no fallback or queue.
fill_model: Observed midpoint research proxy, not executable fill. Store bid/ask; fixed0.10pp all-in scenario includes spread, never subtract spread twice.
exit: First observed midpoint threshold crossing or first quote requested at/after holding deadline. OBSERVED outcomes are discrete samples, not proof of intragap first-touch or execution.
gaps: A quote gap greater than30seconds or open-position restart marks path_uncertain permanently. Retain every outcome with its flags.
source_identity: New forward study, not retrospective data or previous backtest. No exchange/account/order/notification access.
bounds_are_protocol_choices: 10second polling,90second entry expiry,5second quote roundtrip,30second gap flag are frozen research settings, not measured latency guarantees.
clock_scope: Render observer DB response receipt; distinct from alert delivery and exchange execution
